officialText:
An eligible basement or cellar residence must be in compliance with any additional safety or construction requirements established pursuant to rules promulgated by the department in consultation with the fire department and the office of emergency management.

(L.L. 2024/126, 12/18/2024, eff. 6/16/2025)
